spans.s: Dauḥsādhasādhanika (EI 30; HD), explained as ‘those who catch dangerous robbers whom it is difficult to secure’. See Ep. Ind., Vol. IV, p. 211. Cf. Duḥsādhasādhanika (ibid., Vol. XI, p. 310), Dussādhyasādhaka, Duṣṭasāhanī, Mahādauḥsādhanika, etc.
Dauḥsādhika (IE 8-3; HD), same as Dauḥsādhasādhanika, [] Duḥsādhyasādhanika, Dussādhyasādhaka, Duṣṭasāhani, etc. See Ep. Ind., Vol. XII, p. 9. Lexicons explain it as ‘gate-keeper’.
